caption: The drawing is a technical blueprint of a table, shown in three views: end elevation (top left), side elevation (top right), and top view (bottom left). The table features a rectangular top with approximate dimensions of 36 inches in width and 23 inches in depth. The end elevation view shows a single-drawer in the center of the table, bracketed by four straight legs extending downward and then curving outward to form feet, each terminating in a scroll-like shape. The side elevation displays the table’s gently curved apron and pedestal base, with the central support leading to four curved legs. The top view illustrates the rectangular tabletop and the arrangement of the four curved legs extending diagonally from the center of the table’s underside. Measurements and construction lines are present, with dimension notations in inches beside several key features. There are handwritten annotations in red ink to the right of the drawing, noting table number, date, and a name. The drawing is composed in black ink linework on an off-white, aged paper background, with some stains and discoloration around the edges.
title: Drop Leaf, Pedestal Table
